# Public verification fixture

`message.txt`, `message.txt.minisig`, `minisign.pub` and `LICENSE` are the
existing public verification vector from [aead/minisign v0.3.0](https://github.com/aead/minisign/tree/v0.3.0/internal/testdata).
No private key is copied or generated. The fixture proves minisign verification
and tamper rejection; it does not prove a PassShare candidate or any OS signature.
